title: Roof replacement under solar panels, covered by insurance in Humble
shortStory: This Humble homeowner worried that replacing the roof under their solar panels would be extremely expensive. We documented covered storm damage and helped get both the roof replacement and the solar-panel removal-and-reinstall approved through insurance — coordinating the entire project even though the original solar company had gone out of business.
longStory:
This Humble homeowner was concerned that replacing an aging roof beneath existing solar panels would cost thousands of dollars out of pocket.

After inspecting the roof following a recent storm, Northvale Roofing identified covered storm damage and helped secure insurance approval for both the roof replacement and the removal and reinstallation of the solar panels. Even though the original solar company was no longer in business, our trusted solar specialists handled that part of the process from start to finish.

The homeowner ended up with a beautiful new roof while protecting their investment in solar energy — and avoiding a significant, unexpected expense.

If you need roof replacement, storm-damage repairs, or insurance-claim help for a home with solar panels, we're glad to help.
